_comment: PRIOR ART: scripts/analysis/cluster-books.py — clusters whole books, not passages about one person. One entry per figure: prefix = the full-text prefix searched in pages_en (prefix*); name = the regex that names him in a sentence; out = where the page data is published; minCluster/minSamples = HDBSCAN settings for the theme map (about passages/250, floor 10). setAside = passages whose book title matches `titles` and text matches `text` (both default to anything), and whose text does not match `unless`, are given a fixed theme before clustering: they name someone else, or the figure as a fictional speaker.

setAside.why: Philolaus as a speaker in Reuchlin's dialogue De arte cabalistica (1517), reprinted with Galatinus and Pico
Philolaus, a companion of Apollonius in Philostratus, not the Pythagorean
Archytas of Amphissa, the poet Athenaeus quotes on apples
